definition.name: Cash Dashboard
definition.comment: R014 read-only Bangkok MTD: signed income/expenses, completed per-partner FIFO withdrawals from inception, net unsettled profit, available contributed capital and positive initialized account custody. Role A=Tommy, B=Lisa. Unknown account openings keep business cash unavailable. No base-data writes.
definition.view_definition:
WITH ctx AS (
         SELECT q.d,
            date_trunc('month'::text, q.d::timestamp with time zone)::date AS ms
           FROM ( SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS d) q
        ), profit AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(r."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" >= ctx.ms AND NOT r.loss_pair), 0::numeric) AS income,
            COALESCE(sum(r."Partner A Profit") FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" < ctx.ms), 0::numeric) AS prior_a,
            COALESCE(sum(r."Partner B Profit") FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" < ctx.ms), 0::numeric) AS prior_b,
            COALESCE(sum(r."Partner A Profit") FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" >= ctx.ms), 0::numeric) AS month_a,
            COALESCE(sum(r."Partner B Profit") FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" >= ctx.ms), 0::numeric) AS month_b,
            COALESCE(sum(r."Principal Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" >= ctx.ms AND r.loss_pair), 0::numeric) AS writeoff
           FROM ( SELECT wx."Row ID",
                    wx."Payment Date",
                    wx."Principal Paid",
                    wx."Interest Paid",
                    wx."Notes",
                    wx."Ref Loans",
                    wx."Ref Charges",
                    wx."Created By",
                    wx."Ref Payment",
                    wx."Ref Payment Allocation",
                    wx."Principal Returned Days MTD",
                    wx."Pool Total at Payment Date",
                    wx."Partner A Contribution at Payment Date",
                    wx."Partner B Contribution at Payment Date",
                    wx."Partner A Profit Share",
                    wx."Partner B Profit Share",
                    wx."Partner A Profit",
                    wx."Partner B Profit",
                    wx."30D Principal Reduction Days",
                    wx."Amount Received",
                    is_principal_writeoff(wx."Row ID", wx."Ref Payment", wx."Principal Paid"::numeric, wx."Interest Paid"::numeric, wx."Ref Charges", wc.principal, wc.interest, wc.repayments) AS loss_pair
                   FROM olap_repayments_analytics wx
                     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c."Principal Due"::numeric AS principal,
                            c."Interest Due"::numeric AS interest,
                            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                                   FROM "Repayments" n
                                  WHERE n."Ref Charges" = c."Row ID") AS repayments
                           FROM "Charges" c
                          WHERE c."Row ID" = wx."Ref Charges" AND wx."Ref Payment" IS NULL AND wx."Principal Paid"::numeric > 0::numeric AND wx."Interest Paid"::numeric = (- wx."Principal Paid"::numeric)) wc ON true) r
             CROSS JOIN ctx
          WHERE r."Payment Date" <= ctx.d
        ), expense AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(e."Amount"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE e."Expense Date" >= ctx.ms), 0::numeric) AS amount,
            COALESCE(sum(e."Partner A Expense"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE e."Expense Date" < ctx.ms), 0::numeric) AS prior_a,
            COALESCE(sum(e."Partner B Expense"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE e."Expense Date" < ctx.ms), 0::numeric) AS prior_b,
            COALESCE(sum(e."Partner A Expense"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE e."Expense Date" >= ctx.ms), 0::numeric) AS month_a,
            COALESCE(sum(e."Partner B Expense"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE e."Expense Date" >= ctx.ms), 0::numeric) AS month_b
           FROM "Business Expenses" e
             CROSS JOIN ctx
          WHERE e."Expense Date" <= ctx.d
        ), settled AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(s."Amount"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE p."Partner Role" = 'A'::text), 0::numeric) AS a,
            COALESCE(sum(s."Amount"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE p."Partner Role" = 'B'::text), 0::numeric) AS b
           FROM "Settlements" s
             JOIN "Partners" p ON p."Row ID" = s."Ref Partner"
             CROSS JOIN ctx
          WHERE s."Status" = 'Completed'::text AND s."Transfer Date" <= ctx.d
        ), allocated AS (
         SELECT profit.income,
            expense.amount,
            profit.writeoff,
            fifo_current_month_settled(profit.prior_a - expense.prior_a, profit.month_a - expense.month_a, settled.a) AS a,
            fifo_current_month_settled(profit.prior_b - expense.prior_b, profit.month_b - expense.month_b, settled.b) AS b
           FROM profit
             CROSS JOIN expense
             CROSS JOIN settled
        ), cash AS (
         SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_and("Cash Account Balances"."Initialized") THEN sum("Cash Account Balances"."Business Cash Held")
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS held
           FROM "Cash Account Balances"
        )
 SELECT 'cash-dashboard'::text AS "Row ID",
    allocated.income AS "Operating Income MTD",
    - allocated.amount AS "Expenses MTD",
    allocated.income - allocated.amount - allocated.writeoff AS "Net Profit MTD",
    - allocated.a AS "Tommy Withdrawn MTD",
    - allocated.b AS "Lisa Withdrawn MTD",
    allocated.income - allocated.amount - allocated.writeoff - allocated.a - allocated.b AS "Unsettled Profit MTD",
    pool."Available Cashpool"::numeric AS "Cash Pool Remaining",
    cash.held AS "Business Cash Held",
    allocated.writeoff AS "Principal Write-offs MTD"
   FROM allocated
     CROSS JOIN "Loan Form Context" pool
     CROSS JOIN cash;

definition.name: olap_portfolio_summary
definition.view_definition:
WITH ctx AS (
         SELECT q.d,
            date_trunc('month'::text, q.d::timestamp with time zone)::date AS ms,
            (date_trunc('month'::text, q.d::timestamp with time zone) + '1 mon -1 days'::interval)::date AS me
           FROM ( SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS d) q
        ), lr AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(olap_loans_analytics."Outstanding Principal"), 0::numeric) AS principal,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE olap_loans_analytics."Loan Status" = 'ยังไม่ปิดยอด'::text) AS active,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_loans_analytics."Expected Interest This Month"), 0::numeric) AS forecast,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_loans_analytics."Principal Days MTD"), 0::numeric) AS days,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_loans_analytics."Expected Daily Interest Amount"), 0::numeric) AS daily,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_loans_analytics."Total Interest Received") FILTER (WHERE olap_loans_analytics."Loan Status" = 'ยังไม่ปิดยอด'::text), 0::numeric) AS active_profit,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_loans_analytics."Default Loss Amount"::numeric), 0::numeric) AS principal_loss
           FROM olap_loans_analytics
        ), rr AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(repayments."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE NOT repayments.loss_pair), 0::numeric) AS profit,
            COALESCE(sum(repayments."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE repayments."Payment Date" = ctx.d AND NOT repayments.loss_pair), 0::numeric) AS today,
            COALESCE(sum(repayments."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE repayments."Payment Date" = (ctx.d - 1) AND NOT repayments.loss_pair), 0::numeric) AS yesterday,
            COALESCE(sum(repayments."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE repayments."Payment Date" >= ctx.ms AND repayments."Payment Date" <= ctx.me AND NOT repayments.loss_pair), 0::numeric) AS mtd,
            COALESCE(sum(repayments."Principal Returned Days MTD"), 0::numeric) AS returned_days,
            COALESCE(sum(repayments."Partner A Profit"), 0::numeric) AS profit_a,
            COALESCE(sum(repayments."Partner B Profit"), 0::numeric) AS profit_b,
            COALESCE(sum(repayments."Principal Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE repayments.loss_pair), 0::numeric) AS writeoff,
            COALESCE(sum(repayments."Principal Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE repayments."Payment Date" >= ctx.ms AND repayments."Payment Date" <= ctx.me AND repayments.loss_pair), 0::numeric) AS writeoff_mtd
           FROM ( SELECT wx."Row ID",
                    wx."Payment Date",
                    wx."Principal Paid",
                    wx."Interest Paid",
                    wx."Notes",
                    wx."Ref Loans",
                    wx."Ref Charges",
                    wx."Created By",
                    wx."Ref Payment",
                    wx."Ref Payment Allocation",
                    wx."Principal Returned Days MTD",
                    wx."Pool Total at Payment Date",
                    wx."Partner A Contribution at Payment Date",
                    wx."Partner B Contribution at Payment Date",
                    wx."Partner A Profit Share",
                    wx."Partner B Profit Share",
                    wx."Partner A Profit",
                    wx."Partner B Profit",
                    wx."30D Principal Reduction Days",
                    wx."Amount Received",
                    is_principal_writeoff(wx."Row ID", wx."Ref Payment", wx."Principal Paid"::numeric, wx."Interest Paid"::numeric, wx."Ref Charges", wc.principal, wc.interest, wc.repayments) AS loss_pair
                   FROM olap_repayments_analytics wx
                     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c."Principal Due"::numeric AS principal,
                            c."Interest Due"::numeric AS interest,
                            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                                   FROM "Repayments" n
                                  WHERE n."Ref Charges" = c."Row ID") AS repayments
                           FROM "Charges" c
                          WHERE c."Row ID" = wx."Ref Charges" AND wx."Ref Payment" IS NULL AND wx."Principal Paid"::numeric > 0::numeric AND wx."Interest Paid"::numeric = (- wx."Principal Paid"::numeric)) wc ON true) repayments
             CROSS JOIN ctx
        ), cr AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(olap_charges_analytics."Amount Remaining") FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(olap_charges_analytics."Ref Loans", ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND olap_charges_analytics."Charge Date" <= ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS pending,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_charges_analytics."Interest Remaining") FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(olap_charges_analytics."Ref Loans", ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND olap_charges_analytics."Charge Date" <= ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS interest,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_charges_analytics."Amount Due") FILTER (WHERE olap_charges_analytics."Charge Date" = ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS due,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_charges_analytics."Total Paid") FILTER (WHERE olap_charges_analytics."Charge Date" = ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS paid,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_charges_analytics."Amount Remaining") FILTER (WHERE olap_charges_analytics."Charge Date" = ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS remaining
           FROM olap_charges_analytics
             CROSS JOIN ctx
        ), br AS (
         SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE olap_borrowers_analytics."Daily Collection Status" = 'Fully Paid'::text) AS full_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE olap_borrowers_analytics."Daily Collection Status" = 'Partially Paid'::text) AS partial_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE olap_borrowers_analytics."Daily Collection Status" = 'Overdue'::text) AS overdue_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE olap_borrowers_analytics."Daily Collection Status" = 'Not Paid'::text) AS notpaid_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE olap_borrowers_analytics."Daily Collection Status" = 'Long Overdue'::text) AS long_overdue_count
           FROM olap_borrowers_analytics
        ), top3 AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(q.v), 0::numeric) AS total
           FROM ( SELECT "Borrowers"."Total Outstanding Principal" AS v
                   FROM "Borrowers"
                  WHERE "Borrowers"."Total Outstanding Principal" > 0::numeric
                  ORDER BY "Borrowers"."Total Outstanding Principal" DESC
                 LIMIT 3) q
        ), pool AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN "Cash Pool Contributions"."Transaction Type" = 'Contribution'::text THEN "Cash Pool Contributions"."Amount"::numeric
                    ELSE - "Cash Pool Contributions"."Amount"::numeric
                END), 0::numeric) AS total
           FROM "Cash Pool Contributions"
        ), settled AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(s."Amount"::numeric), 0::numeric) AS total
           FROM "Settlements" s
             JOIN "Partners" p ON p."Row ID" = s."Ref Partner"
          WHERE s."Status" = 'Completed'::text
        ), earned AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(
                CASE p."Partner Role"
                    WHEN 'A'::text THEN rr.profit_a
                    WHEN 'B'::text THEN rr.profit_b
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END), 0::numeric) AS total
           FROM "Partners" p
             CROSS JOIN rr
        ), er AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum("Business Expenses"."Amount"::numeric), 0::numeric) AS total,
            COALESCE(sum("Business Expenses"."Amount"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE "Business Expenses"."Expense Date" >= ctx.ms AND "Business Expenses"."Expense Date" <= ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS mtd
           FROM "Business Expenses"
             CROSS JOIN ctx
        ), recent AS (
         SELECT a."Row ID",
            a."Snapshot Date",
            a."Generated At",
            a."Model Version",
            a."Principal Issued",
            a."Loans Issued",
            a."Principal Returned",
            a."Interest Received",
            a."Repayments Count",
            a."Outstanding Principal EOD",
            a."Active Loans EOD",
            a."Active Borrowers EOD",
            a."Pending Charges EOD",
            a."Total Cash Pool EOD",
            a."Available Cash EOD",
            a."Unsettled Profit EOD",
            a."Business Expenses",
            a."Net Profit",
            a."Net Unsettled Profit EOD",
            a."Capital Contributed",
            a."Capital Withdrawn",
            a."Partner Settlements",
            a."Partner A Net Profit",
            a."Partner B Net Profit",
            a."Partner A Settlements",
            a."Partner B Settlements",
            a."Cash Money In",
            a."Cash Money Out",
            a."Cash Opening Balance",
            a."Cash Balance EOD",
            a."Cash Available From",
            a."Cash Balance Status"
           FROM "Daily Analytics" a
          WHERE a."Snapshot Date" >= ((CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text) - '30 days'::interval)
        ), peak AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(max(recent."Outstanding Principal EOD"::numeric), 0::numeric) AS amount
           FROM recent
        ), peakdate AS (
         SELECT max(recent."Snapshot Date") AS dt
           FROM recent
             CROSS JOIN peak
          WHERE recent."Outstanding Principal EOD"::numeric = peak.amount
        ), a AS (
         SELECT s."Row ID",
            s."Statistics ID",
            rr.profit AS "Total Profit",
            lr.principal AS "Outstanding Principal",
            lr.principal AS "Total Outstanding Principal",
            lr.active AS "Active Loans",
            rr.today AS "Today's Profit",
            rr.yesterday AS "Yesterday's Profit",
            rr.mtd AS "Realized Profit MTD",
            rr.mtd + cr.interest + lr.forecast AS "Projected Monthly Profit",
            cr.pending AS "Pending Payment Amount",
            lr.forecast AS "Forecast Remaining Interest",
            cr.interest AS "Today's Outstanding Interest",
            lr.days - rr.returned_days AS "Net Principal Days MTD",
            lr.principal * (ctx.me - ctx.d)::numeric AS "Forecast Remaining Principal Days",
            round((lr.days - rr.returned_days + lr.principal * (ctx.me - ctx.d)::numeric) / EXTRACT(day FROM ctx.me)) AS "Forecast Average Daily Outstanding Principal",
            peak.amount AS "Peak Cash Pool 30D",
            peakdate.dt AS "Peak Cash Pool Date 30D",
            lr.daily AS "Expected Daily Interest",
            lr.active_profit AS "Total Profit of Outstanding Loans",
                CASE
                    WHEN lr.principal > 0::numeric THEN lr.active_profit / lr.principal
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS "Profit Coverage of Outstanding Principal",
            pool.total AS "Total Cash Pool",
            earned.total - settled.total AS "Total Unsettled Profit",
            pool.total - lr.principal + earned.total - settled.total AS "Expected Loan Account Balance",
                CASE
                    WHEN lr.principal = 0::numeric THEN 0::numeric
                    ELSE top3.total / lr.principal
                END AS "Top 3 Borrower Concentration",
            br.full_count AS "Borrowers Fully Paid Today",
            br.partial_count AS "Borrowers Partially Paid Today",
            br.overdue_count AS "Borrowers with Overdue Payment",
            br.notpaid_count AS "Borrowers Not Paid Today",
            cr.due AS "Amount Due Today",
            cr.paid AS "Amount Collected Today",
            cr.remaining AS "Amount Outstanding Today",
                CASE
                    WHEN cr.due = 0::numeric THEN 0::numeric
                    ELSE cr.paid / cr.due
                END AS "Amount Collection Rate Today",
            er.total AS "Total Business Expenses",
            rr.profit - rr.writeoff - er.total AS "Net Profit",
            er.mtd AS "Expenses MTD",
            rr.mtd - rr.writeoff_mtd - er.mtd AS "Net Profit MTD",
            earned.total - settled.total - er.total AS "Net Unsettled Profit",
            pool.total - lr.principal + earned.total - settled.total - er.total AS "Net Expected Loan Account Balance",
            rr.mtd AS "Operating Income MTD",
            - er.mtd AS "Income Statement Expenses MTD",
            br.long_overdue_count AS "Borrowers with Long Overdue Payment",
            lr.principal_loss AS "Total Principal Loss",
            rr.writeoff_mtd AS "Principal Write-offs MTD",
            rr.writeoff AS "Principal Write-offs"
           FROM "Statistics" s
             CROSS JOIN ctx
             CROSS JOIN lr
             CROSS JOIN rr
             CROSS JOIN cr
             CROSS JOIN br
             CROSS JOIN top3
             CROSS JOIN pool
             CROSS JOIN settled
             CROSS JOIN earned
             CROSS JOIN er
             CROSS JOIN peak
             CROSS JOIN peakdate
        ), final AS (
         SELECT a."Row ID",
            a."Statistics ID",
            a."Total Profit",
            a."Outstanding Principal",
            a."Total Outstanding Principal",
            a."Active Loans",
            a."Today's Profit",
            a."Yesterday's Profit",
            a."Realized Profit MTD",
            a."Projected Monthly Profit",
            a."Pending Payment Amount",
            a."Forecast Remaining Interest",
            a."Today's Outstanding Interest",
            a."Net Principal Days MTD",
            a."Forecast Remaining Principal Days",
            a."Forecast Average Daily Outstanding Principal",
            a."Peak Cash Pool 30D",
            a."Peak Cash Pool Date 30D",
            a."Expected Daily Interest",
            a."Total Profit of Outstanding Loans",
            a."Profit Coverage of Outstanding Principal",
            a."Total Cash Pool",
            a."Total Unsettled Profit",
            a."Expected Loan Account Balance",
            a."Top 3 Borrower Concentration",
            a."Borrowers Fully Paid Today",
            a."Borrowers Partially Paid Today",
            a."Borrowers with Overdue Payment",
            a."Borrowers Not Paid Today",
            a."Amount Due Today",
            a."Amount Collected Today",
            a."Amount Outstanding Today",
            a."Amount Collection Rate Today",
            a."Total Business Expenses",
            a."Net Profit",
            a."Expenses MTD",
            a."Net Profit MTD",
            a."Net Unsettled Profit",
            a."Net Expected Loan Account Balance",
            a."Operating Income MTD",
            a."Income Statement Expenses MTD",
            a."Borrowers with Long Overdue Payment",
            a."Total Principal Loss",
            a."Principal Write-offs MTD",
            a."Principal Write-offs",
                CASE
                    WHEN a."Forecast Average Daily Outstanding Principal" > 0::numeric THEN a."Projected Monthly Profit" / a."Forecast Average Daily Outstanding Principal"
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS "Forecast Monthly Return on ADO"
           FROM a
        )
 SELECT "Row ID",
    "Statistics ID",
    round("Total Profit", 0) AS "Total Profit",
    round("Outstanding Principal", 0) AS "Outstanding Principal",
    "Active Loans",
    round("Today's Profit", 0) AS "Today's Profit",
    round("Yesterday's Profit", 0) AS "Yesterday's Profit",
    round("Realized Profit MTD", 0) AS "Realized Profit MTD",
    round("Projected Monthly Profit", 0) AS "Projected Monthly Profit",
    round("Pending Payment Amount", 0) AS "Pending Payment Amount",
    round("Forecast Remaining Interest", 0) AS "Forecast Remaining Interest",
    round("Today's Outstanding Interest", 0) AS "Today's Outstanding Interest",
    "Net Principal Days MTD",
    "Forecast Remaining Principal Days",
    round("Forecast Average Daily Outstanding Principal", 0) AS "Forecast Average Daily Outstanding Principal",
    round("Forecast Monthly Return on ADO", 2) AS "Forecast Monthly Return on ADO",
    round("Peak Cash Pool 30D", 0) AS "Peak Cash Pool 30D",
    "Peak Cash Pool Date 30D",
    round("Expected Daily Interest", 0) AS "Expected Daily Interest",
    round("Total Profit of Outstanding Loans", 0) AS "Total Profit of Outstanding Loans",
    round("Profit Coverage of Outstanding Principal", 2) AS "Profit Coverage of Outstanding Principal",
    round("Total Cash Pool", 0) AS "Total Cash Pool",
    round("Total Unsettled Profit", 0) AS "Total Unsettled Profit",
    round("Expected Loan Account Balance", 0) AS "Expected Loan Account Balance",
    round("Total Outstanding Principal", 0) AS "Total Outstanding Principal",
    round("Top 3 Borrower Concentration", 4) AS "Top 3 Borrower Concentration",
    "Borrowers Fully Paid Today",
    "Borrowers Partially Paid Today",
    "Borrowers with Overdue Payment",
    "Borrowers Not Paid Today",
    round("Amount Due Today", 0) AS "Amount Due Today",
    round("Amount Collected Today", 0) AS "Amount Collected Today",
    round("Amount Outstanding Today", 0) AS "Amount Outstanding Today",
    "Amount Collection Rate Today",
    round("Total Business Expenses", 0) AS "Total Business Expenses",
    round("Net Profit", 0) AS "Net Profit",
    round("Expenses MTD", 0) AS "Expenses MTD",
    round("Net Profit MTD", 0) AS "Net Profit MTD",
    round("Net Unsettled Profit", 0) AS "Net Unsettled Profit",
    round("Net Expected Loan Account Balance", 0) AS "Net Expected Loan Account Balance",
    round("Income Statement Expenses MTD", 0) AS "Income Statement Expenses MTD",
    round("Operating Income MTD", 0) AS "Operating Income MTD",
    "Borrowers with Long Overdue Payment",
    round("Total Principal Loss", 0) AS "Total Principal Loss",
    round("Principal Write-offs MTD", 0) AS "Principal Write-offs MTD",
    round("Principal Write-offs", 0) AS "Principal Write-offs"
   FROM final x;

definition.name: reporting_income_daily
definition.comment: R016: database-owned Income Statement source. Live Bangkok dates; original model grain and financial semantics preserved.
definition.view_definition:
WITH income AS (
         SELECT repayments."Payment Date" AS d,
            sum(repayments."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE NOT repayments.loss_pair) AS income,
            sum(repayments."Partner A Profit") AS pa,
            sum(repayments."Partner B Profit") AS pb,
            sum(repayments."Principal Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE repayments.loss_pair) AS writeoff
           FROM ( SELECT wx."Row ID",
                    wx."Payment Date",
                    wx."Principal Paid",
                    wx."Interest Paid",
                    wx."Notes",
                    wx."Ref Loans",
                    wx."Ref Charges",
                    wx."Created By",
                    wx."Ref Payment",
                    wx."Ref Payment Allocation",
                    wx."Principal Returned Days MTD",
                    wx."Pool Total at Payment Date",
                    wx."Partner A Contribution at Payment Date",
                    wx."Partner B Contribution at Payment Date",
                    wx."Partner A Profit Share",
                    wx."Partner B Profit Share",
                    wx."Partner A Profit",
                    wx."Partner B Profit",
                    wx."30D Principal Reduction Days",
                    wx."Amount Received",
                    is_principal_writeoff(wx."Row ID", wx."Ref Payment", wx."Principal Paid"::numeric, wx."Interest Paid"::numeric, wx."Ref Charges", wc.principal, wc.interest, wc.repayments) AS loss_pair
                   FROM olap_repayments_analytics wx
                     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c."Principal Due"::numeric AS principal,
                            c."Interest Due"::numeric AS interest,
                            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                                   FROM "Repayments" n
                                  WHERE n."Ref Charges" = c."Row ID") AS repayments
                           FROM "Charges" c
                          WHERE c."Row ID" = wx."Ref Charges" AND wx."Ref Payment" IS NULL AND wx."Principal Paid"::numeric > 0::numeric AND wx."Interest Paid"::numeric = (- wx."Principal Paid"::numeric)) wc ON true) repayments
          WHERE repayments."Payment Date" <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date
          GROUP BY repayments."Payment Date"
        ), expenses AS (
         SELECT "Business Expenses"."Expense Date" AS d,
            sum("Business Expenses"."Amount"::numeric) AS expense,
            sum("Business Expenses"."Partner A Expense"::numeric) AS pa,
            sum("Business Expenses"."Partner B Expense"::numeric) AS pb
           FROM "Business Expenses"
          WHERE "Business Expenses"."Expense Date" <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date
          GROUP BY "Business Expenses"."Expense Date"
        ), settled AS (
         SELECT unnamed_subquery."Transfer Date" AS d,
            COALESCE(sum(unnamed_subquery."Amount") FILTER (WHERE unnamed_subquery."Partner Role" = 'A'::text), 0::numeric) AS pa,
            COALESCE(sum(unnamed_subquery."Amount") FILTER (WHERE unnamed_subquery."Partner Role" = 'B'::text), 0::numeric) AS pb
           FROM ( SELECT s."Row ID" AS "Settlement ID",
                    s."Ref Partner" AS "Partner ID",
                    p."Partner Name" AS "Partner",
                    p."Partner Role",
                    s."Transfer Date",
                    s."Amount"::numeric AS "Amount",
                    s."Status"
                   FROM "Settlements" s
                     LEFT JOIN "Partners" p ON p."Row ID" = s."Ref Partner"
                  WHERE s."Transfer Date" <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date) unnamed_subquery
          WHERE unnamed_subquery."Status" = 'Completed'::text
          GROUP BY unnamed_subquery."Transfer Date"
        ), bounds AS (
         SELECT min(dates.d) AS first_date
           FROM ( SELECT income.d
                   FROM income
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT expenses.d
                   FROM expenses
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT settled.d
                   FROM settled) dates
        ), calendar AS (

WITH income AS (

            sum(unnamed_subquery."Interest Paid") FILTER (WHERE NOT unnamed_subquery."Loss Pair") AS amount,
            sum(unnamed_subquery."Principal Paid") FILTER (WHERE unnamed_subquery."Loss Pair") AS writeoff
           FROM ( WITH context AS (
                         SELECT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date AS today
                        )
                 SELECT r."Row ID" AS "Repayment ID",
                    r."Ref Loans" AS "Loan ID",
                    l."Borrower ID",
                    l."Borrower",
                    l."Hidden",
                    l."Loan Type",
                    r."Payment Date",
                    r."Interest Paid"::numeric AS "Interest Paid",
                    r."Principal Paid"::numeric AS "Principal Paid",
                    r.loss_pair AS "Loss Pair",
                        CASE
                            WHEN r."Payment Date" >= (c.today - 29) AND r."Payment Date" <= c.today THEN r."Interest Paid"::numeric
                            ELSE 0::numeric
                        END AS "Interest 30D",
                        CASE
                            WHEN r."Payment Date" >= (c.today - 6) AND r."Payment Date" <= c.today THEN r."Interest Paid"::numeric
                            ELSE 0::numeric
                        END AS "Interest Recent 7D",
                        CASE
                            WHEN r."Payment Date" >= (c.today - 14) AND r."Payment Date" <= (c.today - 8) THEN r."Interest Paid"::numeric
                            ELSE 0::numeric
                        END AS "Interest Prior 7D",
                    r."Payment Date" >= (c.today - 29) AND r."Payment Date" <= c.today AS "In Last 30 Days"
                   FROM ( SELECT wx."Row ID",
                            wx."Payment Date",
                            wx."Principal Paid",
                            wx."Interest Paid",
                            wx."Notes",
                            wx."Ref Loans",
                            wx."Ref Charges",
                            wx."Created By",
                            wx."Ref Payment",
                            wx."Ref Payment Allocation",
                            wx."Principal Returned Days MTD",
                            wx."Pool Total at Payment Date",
                            wx."Partner A Contribution at Payment Date",
                            wx."Partner B Contribution at Payment Date",
                            wx."Partner A Profit Share",
                            wx."Partner B Profit Share",
                            wx."Partner A Profit",
                            wx."Partner B Profit",
                            wx."30D Principal Reduction Days",
                            wx."Amount Received",
                            is_principal_writeoff(wx."Row ID", wx."Ref Payment", wx."Principal Paid"::numeric, wx."Interest Paid"::numeric, wx."Ref Charges", wc.principal, wc.interest, wc.repayments) AS loss_pair
                           FROM olap_repayments_analytics wx
                             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c_1."Principal Due"::numeric AS principal,
                                    c_1."Interest Due"::numeric AS interest,
                                    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
   FROM "Repayments" n
  WHERE n."Ref Charges" = c_1."Row ID") AS repayments
                                   FROM "Charges" c_1
                                  WHERE c_1."Row ID" = wx."Ref Charges" AND wx."Ref Payment" IS NULL AND wx."Principal Paid"::numeric > 0::numeric AND wx."Interest Paid"::numeric = (- wx."Principal Paid"::numeric)) wc ON true) r
                     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT l_1."Row ID" AS "Loan ID",
                            l_1."Ref Borrowers" AS "Borrower ID",
                            b."Borrower",
                            b."Hidden",
                            l_1."Loan Date",
                                CASE l_1."Loan Type"

                                    WHEN 'ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน'::text THEN 'Daily Interest'::text
                                    WHEN 'ผ่อนชำระรายวัน'::text THEN 'Daily Installment'::text

                                    WHEN 'ยังไม่ปิดยอด'::text THEN 'Active'::text

                            l_1."Loan Age Bucket",

                            date_trunc('week'::text, l_1."Loan Date"::timestamp with time zone)::date AS "Loan Week"
                           FROM olap_loans_analytics l_1
                             LEFT JOIN ( SELECT b_1."Row ID" AS "Borrower ID",

   FROM olap_loans_analytics l_2
  WHERE l_2."Ref Borrowers" = b_1."Row ID" AND l_2."Loan Status" = 'ปิดยอดแล้ว'::text)) AS "Has Closed Loan"
                                   FROM olap_borrowers_analytics b_1) b ON b."Borrower ID" = l_1."Ref Borrowers") l ON l."Loan ID" = r."Ref Loans"
                     CROSS JOIN context c) unnamed_subquery
          WHERE unnamed_subquery."Payment Date" <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('month'::text, unnamed_subquery."Payment Date"::timestamp with time zone)::date)
        ), expenses AS (
         SELECT unnamed_subquery."Expense Month" AS period_month,
            sum(unnamed_subquery."Expense Amount") AS amount
           FROM ( SELECT "Business Expenses"."Row ID" AS "Expense ID",
                    "Business Expenses"."Expense Date",

                    "Business Expenses"."Amount"::numeric AS "Expense Amount",
                    - "Business Expenses"."Amount"::numeric AS "Statement Expense",
                    date_trunc('month'::text, "Business Expenses"."Expense Date"::timestamp with time zone)::date AS "Expense Month",
                    "Business Expenses"."Expense Date" >= date_trunc('month'::text, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text))::date AND "Business Expenses"."Expense Date" <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date AS "In Current Month"
                   FROM "Business Expenses"
                  WHERE "Business Expenses"."Expense Date" <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date) unnamed_subquery
          GROUP BY unnamed_subquery."Expense Month"
        ), bounds AS (
         SELECT min(dates.period_month) AS first_month
           FROM ( SELECT income.period_month
                   FROM income
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT expenses.period_month
                   FROM expenses) dates
        ), months AS (
         SELECT generate_series(COALESCE(bounds.first_month, date_trunc('month'::text, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text))::date)::timestamp with time zone, date_trunc('month'::text, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text))::date::timestamp with time zone, '1 mon'::interval)::date AS period_month
           FROM bounds
        )

    COALESCE(i.amount, 0::numeric) AS "Operating Income",
    COALESCE(e.amount, 0::numeric) AS "Expenses",
    - COALESCE(e.amount, 0::numeric) AS "Signed Expenses",
    COALESCE(i.amount, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(e.amount, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(i.writeoff, 0::numeric) AS "Net Profit",
    (COALESCE(i.amount, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(e.amount, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(i.writeoff, 0::numeric)) / NULLIF(i.amount, 0::numeric) AS "Net Margin",
    m.period_month = date_trunc('month'::text, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text))::date AS "Is Current Month",
        CASE

    COALESCE(i.writeoff, 0::numeric) AS "Principal Write-offs"

     LEFT JOIN expenses e USING (period_month);

                            ELSE NULL::numeric
                        END AS "Holder Cash Component",
                        CASE
                            WHEN "Cash Account Balances"."Initialized" THEN 'Known'::text
                            ELSE 'Opening balance missing'::text
                        END AS "Balance Status"
                   FROM "Cash Account Balances") unnamed_subquery
          WHERE NOT unnamed_subquery."Initialized") AS "Uninitialized Accounts",
        CASE
            WHEN "Business Cash Held" IS NULL THEN 'Account opening balance missing'::text
            WHEN abs("Business Cash Held" - "Cash Pool Remaining" - "Unsettled Profit MTD") < 0.005 THEN 'Reconciled'::text
            ELSE 'Review difference'::text
        END AS "Cash Reconciliation Status",
    "Principal Write-offs MTD"
   FROM "Cash Dashboard" s;

definition.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_principal_writeoff(p_row_id text, p_ref_payment text, p_principal numeric, p_interest numeric, p_charge_id text, p_charge_principal numeric, p_charge_interest numeric, p_charge_repayments bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(starts_with(p_row_id,'df10:') OR (p_ref_payment IS NULL AND p_principal>0 AND p_interest=-p_principal
  AND NOT starts_with(p_charge_id,'lc7:') AND NOT starts_with(p_charge_id,'ls2:')
  AND p_charge_principal=p_principal AND p_charge_interest=-p_principal AND p_charge_repayments=1),false)
$function$
definition.comment: R116 (V130): true for a principal write-off repayment: a df10: posting, or a zero-cash loss pair (no Ref Payment, principal X > 0, interest -X, a non-lc7:/ls2: charge of X/-X with exactly one repayment). Pure; the caller supplies the charge.
